answer: Every agent anchors its identity in a mirror quorum: five verifier nodes hold a signed copy of its behavior profile. Each epoch it must collect whisper attestations, tiny signed pings, from three of them. Mirrors attest only after a karst check, an irregular porous verification path through its recent on-chain actions no script can predict. Forging 1,000 Sybils needs 5,000 bonds at 100 POA each, 500,000 POA locked, plus 10,000 fake histories surviving karst scrutiny. Like shouting in a limestone cave, the echo must return from several chambers or the cave knows the voice is fake.
